lessons_reused: literal expression/category leakage avoided in model-facing English
text and metadata baselines required before any harness claim
position_definition: ten existing Path D CAS expression grammar shapes

binary_composition.gloss: two marked conditions are linked together so the relation between them is the point
binary_composition.plain: two marked conditions are linked into one relation

cross_register_omega.gloss: one named outcome is carried across different modes of presentation without losing its identity
cross_register_omega.plain: one named outcome is viewed across different modes

diagram_export.gloss: a named cluster is packaged as a reusable bundle for outside viewing
diagram_export.plain: a named cluster is packaged for outside viewing

fractal_sequence.gloss: a repeating pattern of moves is applied in order so each pass follows the previous one
fractal_sequence.plain: a repeated pattern of moves is applied in order

inversion.gloss: the usual direction is turned around so source and result exchange their roles
inversion.plain: the usual direction is turned around

let_binding.gloss: a temporary name is introduced first and then reused later inside the same record
let_binding.plain: a temporary name is introduced and later used

meta_logic_relation.gloss: one rule speaks about how another rule relates, follows, or holds together
meta_logic_relation.plain: a rule describes how another rule relates or follows

recipe.gloss: a desired outcome is built from required contributors with different amounts of influence
recipe.plain: a desired outcome is specified by weighted contributors

rpm_chain.gloss: a starting point advances through staged checkpoints before a final pass is reached
rpm_chain.plain: a starting point advances through staged checkpoints

state_literal.gloss: one marked condition stands by itself without another relation attached

source: user-requested Stage 11 expression-shape ladder after Stage 10 five-operator result
